name: Sling (Sling by Toast)
oneLiner: Employee scheduling, time tracking and team messaging app for shift-based businesses, owned by Toast and sold standalone or inside Toast as Sling by Toast.
bestFor: Independent restaurants, cafes and small chains that want low-cost scheduling and team communication, especially Toast POS users.
features: Open shifts, shift swaps, availability and time-off requests
Time clock with clock in/out (paid plans)
Labor cost tracking and overtime management (paid plans)
Toast integration that syncs employees, wages, positions and POS sales into schedules

pricing.text: Free plan for scheduling (capped at 30 users for accounts not created through Toast). Premium $2.00 and Business $4.00 per user per month, or $1.70 and $3.40 billed annually (15% annual discount); 15-day trial on paid plans. Toast customers get Sling Lite ('Scheduling Basics') in every Toast POS package and buy Sling Pro through Toast Shop.

notes: Acquired by Toast in 2021 (https://pos.toasttab.com/th-us/news/toast-acquires-sling-to-expand-its-team-management-suite); now branded 'Sling by Toast' inside Toast, and scheduling in Toast Web is a version of Sling. Price figures come from search snippets of getsling.com/pricing that may be dated; confirm before publishing. Some pages mention a 50-user free tier, conflicting with the 30-user cap. No public customer names or dated 2025-2026 product updates found before the search budget ran out (Toast help articles updated 2026 describe the integration). Current review's pricing matches the annual rates found.
